notes.title: Lewis Quest - Version 1.04
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where you would unlock the 'Gold Medal Time' achievement if you haven't beaten the game yet.

Sorry for the constant patches I forget lines of code sometimes, Thanks for playing :)

notes.title: Lewis Quest - Version 1.03
notes.content:
Changed the 'Gold Medal Time' achievement to be unlocked after completing the game in under 4 minutes and 15 seconds, instead of 4 minutes.
 Added an additional timer to the level complete screens of main and secret levels (not hard mode). This appears when starting in the grasslands, and tracks whole quest time for speedrun achievements.
 Updated the cave level complete screen to be consistent with the level background.
 Removed some spikes in the 2nd secret level to make it a little easier.

Thanks for playing Lewis Quest :)

notes.title: Lewis Quest - Version 1.02
notes.content:
Adjusted parts of hard mode levels to make them slightly easier 
 Fixed a bug where the framed pictures in Calculus Castle hard mode were scaled incorrectly
 Fixed a bug where moving platforms behaved differently with different framerates
 Buffed David

Thanks for playing Lewis Quest :)

notes.title: Lewis Quest - Version 1.01
notes.content:
Removed some ceiling spikes in Calculus Castle
 Made some platforms in Calculus Castle more obvious
 Fixed a bug where players would unlock the 'Empty Pockets' achievement when completing a non-main level

Thanks for playing Lewis Quest :)
